answer: A sybil swarm dies only when each identity costs real, recoverable capital. Require every agent to post a refundable bond that works like a lantern, publicly marking the collateral staked behind one identity. Pass its reputation through a prism so the history splits into peer-attested facets no clone can forge. Bind every action to a single-use nonce thread, so replaying one identity across a thousand fakes snaps the chain and forfeits the bond.
